SLIDER.TITLE: Biab Nailstudio </br> Capelle aan den IJssel

STORY.DESCRIPTION: Is there anything more magical than turning your hobby into your daily job?
STORY.TEXT_1: My name is Carla Luján Bonadero, 30 years old, I like fashion and Latin music.
STORY.TEXT_2: My story as a Nail Artist began in the summer of 2014. Studying the Accounting Degree at the University of Economic Sciences in Cordoba city from my beloved country, Argentina, and free of exams to get pass, I signed up for my first Manicure course.
STORY.TEXT_3: My challenge was improving my basic techniques in this Art, just to attend to the "Inner Spark", that creativeness within me, and don't ignore it, letting it suffocate inside me. I got inspired in the moments dedicated to my own hands – and, of course, to brave women's hands from my intimate circle who trusted me and went through my treatment as a beginner.
STORY.TEXT_4: After completing my accounting studies in March 2018, I dedicated the first 3 years to my profession, while I was studying a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration at the same University. But one day I took courage and, with the unconditional support of who would become my Dear husband months later, I decided to turn my career around. This is how I began to train myself even more as a nail stylist, convincing myself day by day, customer by customer, nail by nail, that the nail care and beauty world was what I was really passionate about and a business that I would want to start with a strong motivation......
STORY.TEXT_5: ......So I created my own business to which I gave the name "Cleos". The name was inspired by the history of this Art.

WORK.TEXT_1: No less than Cleopatra herself from ancient Egypt, where henna was used as a dye, covered her own nails with this natural dye to give them colour. It is believed that reddish tones were reserved for queens, as a sign of rank and power. This is a reassertion that Manicure has been one of the forms of self-expression and reaffirmation of women since time immemorial.
